one_line: Customer service and engagement platform (help desk, messenger, tickets, AI) with REST APIs and a free development workspace.
auth_notes: OAuth2 for app integrations; personal access tokens for direct API access. Free development workspace provided for building and testing apps before publishing to the Intercom App Store.
self_serve_notes: Free development workspace is self-serve for building/testing; production workspace and full API usage require a paid Intercom plan.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Contacts, conversations, tickets, messages, articles, events, tags, teammates, and reporting APIs
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks documented for conversation/ticket/contact events (e.g. create a GitHub issue when a ticket is created)

existing_mcp.note: Intercom has released an official MCP server on its developer platform (2025); community servers also exist. Marked with moderate confidence.

evidence.note: Fetched developer portal confirmed free dev workspace, webhooks + Tickets API guides, and app/integration flows

agent_notes: Free dev workspace makes first call fast. Official MCP existence is my only slight uncertainty.
